## BetterMindustry Pull Request

> This repository is an independent BetterMindustry snapshot. Mindustry's AI Policy applies only to pull requests targeting `Anuken/Mindustry`, not to internal PRs targeting `CodingRouter/BetterMindustry`.

### Checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/bettermindustry/status.md`, and `docs/bettermindustry/workflow.md`.
- [ ] The PR has one clear goal and does not mix unrelated changes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant build and tests, or explained why they could not run.
- [ ] I verified the behavior in a running Worker/Client when the change affects runtime behavior.
- [ ] I updated `status.md`, `changelog.md`, or an ADR when the milestone, architecture, or user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not include build artifacts, runtime saves/logs, generated files, secrets, or personal data.
- [ ] I listed compatibility, migration, protocol, or save-format risks below.
